posts.hook: the market that dumped nvidia last week just bought it all back
posts.caption: wall street rallied nvidia back as jensen huang returned, anthropic's claude ship now reviews and approves pull requests, and epoch found most agent benchmarks are broken. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: jensen huang walked back into nvidia and the nasdaq jumped ==7%==
slides.desc: the market recovered most of last week's tech selloff on his return

slides.title: anthropic's claude ship now reviews, fixes and approves your pull requests
slides.desc: code review is live; auto-fixing checks and policy-based approval are in beta

slides.title: openai and cisco open-source shirudo to shield linux while it patches
slides.desc: it follows openai's pipeline that found 948 linux privilege-escalation bugs

slides.title: epoch audited the agent benchmarks and most of them failed
slides.desc: only mazebench held up; others were gameable or riddled with errors

slides.title: the loop transformer is suddenly everywhere in new ai models
slides.desc: glm-5.4 and two others reuse the same weights to reason deeper without more params

terms.gloss: layers that run several passes to reason more, same weights

slides.title: a claude model claims a major complexity-theory proof, unchecked by humans
slides.desc: it says vp is a proper subset of vnp; no mathematician has verified the proof

terms.gloss: algebra's version of the famous p vs np problem

posts.hook: monday's relief rally didn't survive tuesday
posts.caption: monday's nvidia rally unwound as the stock fell about 7% and anthropic slipped below its ipo price, tidal moved to fully ban ai-generated music, and staff at anthropic and openai say some new models feel too unsafe to release. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: anthropic dropped below its ==$83== ipo price three days after going public
slides.desc: it fell to about $76, down 12%, far under the $111.50 it hit on debut

slides.title: experts say trump effectively overrode nvidia's board to bring huang back
slides.desc: reinstating him before the conduct probe ends could invite shareholder suits

slides.title: anthropic and openai staff say some new models are too unsafe to release
slides.desc: employees cite weak control and misuse risk even as the launch race speeds up

slides.title: tidal will fully ban ai-generated music on december 9
slides.desc: it says ==60%== of uploads on one november day were entirely ai-made

slides.title: gpt-6.2 astra cracked a 1808 archive mystery in 22 minutes
slides.desc: it named an anonymous sketchbook's artist and found a real new source to prove it

slides.title: microsoft hit code red after its 24-hour microsoft 365 outage
slides.desc: internal memos describe a company-wide push to overhaul outage response
